name: Private Eye Agency
source:
When Ahsan finds an ad for a detective agency in need of an assistant, he immediately applies.

He just couldn't have expected the private eye to be a litteral eyeball.

[From [url=https://maxmorkson.itch.io/private-eye-agency-demo]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
阿赫桑看见一家侦探事务所正在招聘助手，立刻递交了申请。

可他怎么也没想到，那位私家侦探居然真是一颗眼球。
